manifest.name: tsc 6.0
manifest.description: The TypeScript compiler of the 6.0 line, the last one written in TypeScript; it runs on Node.js.
notes: Has no single-threaded flag (it rejects --singleThreaded and --checkers): it checks on one thread anyway, so the one-core scenarios run it unchanged. Node.js still runs work such as garbage collection on helper threads, so one core is slower for it, too.
TypeScript 6.0 is an older compiler revision than 7.0 and 7.1: differences to them mix revision and implementation.

manifest.name: tsc 7.0
manifest.runtime: native (Go), started by a Node.js launcher that replaces itself with the binary (execve)
manifest.description: The TypeScript compiler of the 7.0 line, ported to Go by the TypeScript team. The npm package's tsc command is a Node.js launcher that replaces itself with the native binary (process.execve, available in the Node.js of the image).
notes: TypeScript 7.0 is an older compiler revision than the 7.1 builds that tsc 7.1 (beta), tsrs and tsc-rs implement: a comparison with the ports mixes revision and implementation language, and one with tsc 7.1 compares two releases of the same Go compiler.

manifest.name: tsc 7.1 (beta)
manifest.runtime: native (Go), started by a Node.js launcher that replaces itself with the binary (execve)
manifest.description: The TypeScript compiler of the 7.1 line in Go, at the 7.1.0-beta pre-release. Included although it is a beta: it is the packaged Go build of the upstream revision that tsrs targets, so it is the like-for-like counterpart of tsrs.
notes: Pre-release: 7.1 has no stable release yet.

The 7.1.0-beta package was published from microsoft/TypeScript@3e9236361fa97a9e6c685f4833ac457ae2d8c50a (gitHead of its package.json), the revision tsrs states it ports. tsc-rs tracks an earlier 7.1 development build (7.1.0-dev.20261008.1), so a comparison with tsc-rs mixes compiler revision and implementation language.
tsc 7.0 and tsc 7.1 are both written in Go: a comparison between them is between two releases of the same Go compiler, not a change of implementation language.

manifest.name: tsc-rs
manifest.runtime: native (Rust), started by a shell launcher that execs the binary
manifest.description: An experimental port of the TypeScript 7.1 compiler to Rust (pingdotgg/ts-rust). According to its repository, release 0.8.0 tracks the revision behind the 7.1.0-dev.20261008.1 nightly, which is older than 7.1.0-beta.
notes: Experimental: a port, not the TypeScript team's compiler.

UPSTREAM.md of its repository states that releases 0.4.0 to 0.8.0 are pinned to microsoft/TypeScript@fed0bf24149fb1ed36039212648bafdafc1ea10e (the gitHead of typescript@7.1.0-dev.20261008.1), an earlier 7.1 revision than tsc 7.1 (beta) and tsrs: a comparison with them mixes revision and implementation. The npm package itself only reports version 7.1.0-dev.
Its --fast mode is not measured: it changes what the checker does and only the ports have it.

manifest.name: tsrs
manifest.runtime: native (Rust), started by a Node.js launcher that replaces itself with the binary (execve)
manifest.description: An experimental port of the TypeScript 7.1 compiler to Rust (oxc-project/tsrs). It states (typescriptCommit in its package.json) that it tracks the revision of the 7.1.0-beta release, so tsc 7.1 (beta) is its like-for-like counterpart.
notes: Experimental: a port, not the TypeScript team's compiler.

States that it tracks microsoft/TypeScript@3e9236361fa97a9e6c685f4833ac457ae2d8c50a (7.1.0-beta), the revision of tsc 7.1 (beta) in this domain. The benchmark checks that it reports the same diagnostics on the workloads, not that it implements that revision.
Its --fast mode is not measured: it changes what the checker does and only the ports have it.

typeorm-check.title: TypeORM · check
typeorm-check.description: Type check of the TypeORM project (not incremental) without output (--noEmit), with the tool's default settings on four cores.

typeorm-check-1cpu.title: TypeORM · check on one core
typeorm-check-1cpu.description: Type check of the TypeORM project (not incremental) without output on one core, with the tool's single-threaded flag where it has one (tsc 6 has none and runs unchanged).

excalidraw-check-1cpu.title: Excalidraw · check on one core

typeorm-emit.title: TypeORM · emit
typeorm-emit.description: Type check of TypeORM that also writes JavaScript and declaration files (--outDir, --declaration) to an in-memory file system, on four cores. The output directory is emptied before every run, outside the timed window, and the number of files written is verified.
